name: task4-bed-elevation-control
description: This project implements an **Intelligent Remote Bed Elevation Control System** as part of an IoT-based Smart Hospital simulation. It enables remote adjustment of a hospital bed's angle (0°–90°) using a Node-RED dashboard slider connected to a servo motor via an ESP32 microcontroller. The system ensures patient safety through smooth transitions, predefined modes, and automatic adjustments based on patient condition.
